newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Hungarian police probe money laundering in Cyprus.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian police probe money laundering in Cyprus.

text.p: Top brass of Hungary's police force are in Cyprus investigating possible money laundering activities by the Hungarian mafia, Cyprus police said on Thursday.
A statement said that two senior officers would investigate in cooperation with Cyprus police "a possible network of the Hungarian mafia".
"In the framework of investigations which will be carried out, and which primarily concern money laundering, it is expected that contacts with offshore companies will assist inquiries," it said.
Cyprus is a leading offshore centre with more than 28,000 companies registered since the first incentives were offered in the 1970s.
